reviewNotes: CANONICAL-IDENTITY ELECTION (2026-10-03, docs/modeling-debt-dispositions.md, executing Leg C of docs/catalog-identity-migration-design-2026-09-29.md): this identity is the CANONICAL identity of the TMJ pair and the single authoring home for all temporomandibular-joint claims. It was elected because it already carries the spectrum name 'Temporomandibular Joint (TMJ) Disorders', the Dental & Oral body system and the 38 CFR 4.150 dental-and-oral framework; neither identity holds a registered edge, so the election is a naming-ownership decision rather than an edge-preservation one. tmj-dysfunction is reconciled to it as a quarantined pointer record (stable ID retained; the frozen one-to-one identity contract is unmoved) and is no longer an authoring home. Three-notation reconciliation: ME-34's rejection named tmj-dysfunction, the withdrawn batch-6 draft named tmj-disorder, and the roadmap's temporomandibular-disorder is resolved into this canonical entry's name and aliases and was never minted as an ID. The variant name 'tmj dysfunction' remains on the pointer entry's own catalog name: the catalog invariant (tests/catalog.test.ts) forbids an alias colliding with another condition's name or id, so it is NOT carried here while the pointer exists; folding becomes available only if a future catalog-v3 migration retires the pointer ID. The signed ME-34 reopening disposition for the bruxism-awake-sleep to tmj-disorder route is NOT executed by this election; the ME-34 rejection stands unchanged until that edge lands under the design's Stage 3c.
